| <a id="REQ-001"></a>REQ-001 | Leave request submission | HIGH | Employees submit leave requests for future dates, or for past dates within the current month only. Leave is requested in half days: All day, Morning or Afternoon. The employee selects the Project Manager who confirms the request. Leave types include Paid Leave, Maternity Leave and others. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-002"></a>REQ-002 | Requests exceeding the entitlement allowed with manual review | HIGH | A request that exceeds the employee's entitlement can still be submitted; it is flagged for manual review instead of being blocked. Other violations (dates outside the allowed window, a missing required document, an ineligible leave type) block submission. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §3, 4.1; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-003"></a>REQ-003 | Two-step review and approval workflow | HIGH | Step 1: the selected Project Manager confirms or denies the request. Step 2: the Line Manager approves or rejects the confirmed request. An employee who belongs to no project needs no confirmation: the Line Manager is the only approver. Both steps happen by the end of the month of the leave start date; a request still undecided then is cancelled automatically. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-004"></a>REQ-004 | Modify and resubmit after denial or rejection | HIGH | An employee can modify and resubmit a request after it was denied or rejected. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.2 |
| <a id="REQ-005"></a>REQ-005 | Weekly attendance-based notification | MEDIUM | Every Friday the system notifies employees about days they were absent without a leave request and days they were absent with a valid leave request. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.3 |
| <a id="REQ-006"></a>REQ-006 | Annual leave entitlement refresh | HIGH | At the start of each year leave entitlements are refreshed automatically. The system calculates every entitlement from the leave type rules: base days plus one day per N years of service for seniority-based types. The same rules apply in every country. No amounts are imported: the BA replaced the import described in the URS with calculation. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.1, 4.4; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-007"></a>REQ-007 | Leave type management | HIGH | Admins configure leave types, each with its own eligibility rule (gender), entitlement rule (base days, and N years of service per extra day) and documentation requirements. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.5; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-008"></a>REQ-008 | Role-based access | HIGH | Access rights depend on the role: Employee, Project Manager, Line Manager, Admin/HR. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.6, 5 |
| <a id="REQ-009"></a>REQ-009 | Role-specific action dashboards | HIGH | Project Managers and Line Managers have dedicated dashboards that show by default only the requests requiring their action, with filters for request type, employee name, date and request status. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.7 |
| <a id="REQ-010"></a>REQ-010 | Leave statistics reporting | MEDIUM | HR and Line Managers can view leave statistics, with leave usage summarised by unit, department or the entire company. A Line Manager sees their own unit only. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.7; amended by BA decision at GATE-02 review, 2026-09-30 |
| <a id="REQ-011"></a>REQ-011 | Card scanner integration | MEDIUM | The system fetches check-in and check-out times from the existing card scanner system. Processing logic of scanner data is out of scope. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.8, 6 |
| <a id="REQ-012"></a>REQ-012 | Multinational organisational structure | MEDIUM | The organisational structure reflects offices in multiple cities across several countries, enabling role-based access and reporting by country, city or office. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.8 |
| <a id="REQ-013"></a>REQ-013 | Scale and concurrency | HIGH | The system supports up to 33,000 users with performance and reliability under heavy usage, and handles concurrent submissions without delay. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §4.8, 5 |
| <a id="REQ-014"></a>REQ-014 | Web-based and mobile-responsive | HIGH | The system is web-based and mobile-responsive. | URS v1.0 (Leave_Request_User_Requirement_Spec.docx) §5 |
